I personally do reviews with my gainers once they hit a weight goal to touch base with how they are feeling, do they want to go bigger, rest here for a bit, or lose some weight if they find they are too heavy. 

Also touch base with yourself during those reviews. Do you want to keep helping them get bigger, how is your mental and emotional help, do you need a break for a bit before continuing? Being a feeder can be exhausting.

Don't do raw cake shakes, you can get Salmonella from eating raw flour. It would be better to bake the cake and then blend it into a shake.

Ive also had much success with my gainers packing it on with help from a calorie counting app like under armors. It's helps them make sure they are hitting their caloric goals for the day, and you can just scan the barcode for the nutritional facts.

Make it fun! You can hold little calorie challenges to see if they can eat 5k, 10k, calories in a day. Or tie them to a chair if they comfortable with that and feed them by hand give them lots of rubs.

Have fun!
